name: joint-synthetic-programs-v1
priors: Fixed decimal/index/alphabet syntax, injective ordinal class coordinates and raw identity copy. No selected target AST, formula seed, generator RNG, heldout answer or task identity enters program discovery or execution.
selector: 302 fixed numeric programs plus a bounded training-only nested-count grammar; retain all positive-mass compatible programs within64. Prefix beam deduplicates observed child signatures heuristically but keeps distinct final fitting syntaxes. Stop at first fitting depth. Discovery is discrete, outside joint convex CE.
categorical_control: Same retained program bank, frozen training atom-label dictionary, class0 for unsupported entries; complete vocabulary logits and supplied identity-copy prior.
initial_mass_scaling: Multiply each policy's initial_total_mass by the number of retained programs before fitting; endpoints store the resulting total.
controls: Preserve all23 reviewed additional cases in the entire339 report and the separate original35 comparison. Evaluate13 new cases including the independent-label control; retain every fit or execution refusal without counting it as a measured success.
